messages:
maria: Kickoff: need a compact "launch bench microkit" for webinar + socials. Deliverables: 3 tiles (latency / cost / quality), 600x200 email header, 16:9 slide, SVG icon pack, 2s GIF. Mobile-first. Deadline: Wed EOD.
kevin: Got it. Unified sparkline across tiles + per-token micro-panel? Reuse previous sparkline or fresh viz? https://figma.com/file/previous-spark
tara: Use brand navy + accent orange for deltas. Legal flagged contrast previously  I'll run AA checks on label sizes.
sam: I'll draft 3 headline + CTA variants and a 1-line methodology blurb for slide footer.
legal: Reminder: avoid absolute superlatives like "fastest" or "cheapest" unless cited. Use "latency-optimized" / "cost-efficient". Label metrics as p95/p50 and include methodology link.
l10n: Please provide source copy in a separable text layer and exportable CSV for FR/JA. CTAs max 18 chars; include context notes.
design-bot: Task created: FIGMA-1999 — "launch-bench-microkit". Assigned to @kevin, @tara. Due 2025-05-14. Exports: PNG 600x600, PNG 600x200, PNG mobile 320x180, Slide 1920x1080, GIF ~2s, SVG icons.
kevin: Uploaded starter: https://figma.com/file/mini-launch-1999. Artboards: latency, cost, quality, slide, icons. I'll add tokens + a tiny style snippet.
maria: Include alt text + short accessibility description for each asset. Make copy layers modular for quick swaps during review. Also add a 6-node signup microflow: signup -> confirm -> nurture -> webinar -> demo -> follow-up (simple icons).
tara: Plan: static PNGs, GIF for socials (loop ~2s), slide export, SVG icon pack, and Figma tokens. First pass Mon 10:30am PT.
design-bot: Review slot reserved Mon 11:00am PT. Calendar invites sent.
maria: Thanks team 680 This pack feeds webinar slides, launch socials, and inbound email funnels. Flag legal copy edits early.
